change.scope: NamuWiki /w/ Reader snapshots, including Readability fallback
change.filter: Remove all inline svg elements, .svg/.svgz image URLs including case/query/encoded extensions, and SVG data URI images. Drop SVG srcset candidates while retaining raster fallback images.
change.placement: Remove SVG from the cloned document after stamping original block ordinals and before either extraction path. Cached article snapshots supply both the Reader and Markdown/PDF export.
change.livePage: Original DOM is retained, including its SVGs and reading position.

previewContract.display: Isolated Xvfb; private runtime and D-Bus; inherited Wayland sockets removed

regressionCoverage: Real Electron HTTPS wiki fixture with inline SVG, SVG data URI, upper-case .SVG URL with query, encoded .svgz URL, SVG responsive candidate and valid raster PNG.
SVG absent from visible Reader and raw article snapshot used for exports; PNG, tables, links and details retained.
Real double-click restoration to the original leaf div and original SVG still present in the live page.
Same SVG filtering and retained PNG through the generic Readability fallback on the Namu host.
Image-bearing Reader teardown followed by another article, with no page errors.

initialFailure.symptom: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'scrollTop') after leaving the image-bearing Reader.
initialFailure.cause: A queued scroll can arrive after Svelte clears the bound container. Post-mount work and cleanup also assumed the bound reference remained live.
initialFailure.fix: Ignore scrolls from unmounted readers; retain a stable element for cleanup and cancel obsolete image-settlement, post-tick positioning/focus and menu completion.

limits: Image URLs with no identifiable SVG extension/data MIME cannot be classified by this DOM filter; inline SVG elements are always removed.
No file-format fetching or content sniffing is added during extraction.
The latency benchmark covers ordinary Markdown and Git transitions, not Namu extraction latency.
Production source/build updated; separately installed desktop app not replaced.

benchmark.harness: candidate; same tests for both apps; five cycles per fresh process
benchmark.measurement: Escape keydown to latest-content nonempty native capture; includes polling/IPC/readback, not monitor presentation
